privacy:
What MLWINT does: it reads files to check them and writes its own reports, memory and settings in the MLWINT folder.
What it never does: delete, move, quarantine, run or upload your files. Every step in a report is for you to do.
What leaves this PC: nothing - unless you switch Hash lookup on; then only SHA-256 fingerprints are sent to the services whose keys you entered. Never the file, its name or its folder.
Large-file check: Microsoft Defender is asked to scan in report-only mode: it changes nothing.
